news.title: Rajinikanth's Dharman Aiming for Pongal 2027 Arrival
news.summary: Superstar Rajinikanth's 173rd venture, Dharman, is gearing up for a theatrical release during Pongal 2027. Directed by Ashwath Marimuthu and backed by Kamal Haasan's Raaj Kamal Films International, the production features an ensemble cast including Ram Pothineni, Simran, and Raashii Khanna. Filming is currently progressing rapidly with intense action sequences underway.

news.title: Speculation Surrounds Mahesh Babu's Next Venture After Varanasi
news.summary: As Mahesh Babu wraps up his portions for SS Rajamouli's upcoming directorial Varanasi, discussion surrounding his next cinematic outing has intensified. While directors like Buchi Babu Sana and Sandeep Reddy Vanga have been linked to the star, recent announcements from Lokesh Kanagaraj's production banner have sparked fresh fan speculation. However, no official confirmation regarding an actor-director collaboration has been made.

news.title: Nani and Srikanth Odela Explain Trolled Line in The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani and director Srikanth Odela have addressed online criticism regarding a specific dialogue in their recent release, The Paradise. The filmmaker clarified that a foundational backstory explaining the line was edited out to control the runtime, leading to misinterpretation by viewers. Despite the chatter, the movie continues its strong box office run toward the 150 crore gross milestone.

news.title: Taapsee Pannu Shines in New Retro-Themed Photoshoot
news.summary: Actress Taapsee Pannu recently charmed fans with a bold new vintage-themed photoshoot featuring voluminous curls and a floral ensemble. On the professional front, the actress is currently filming Woh Ladki Hai Kahaan? after her earlier 2026 releases faced box office setbacks.

news.title: Sai Durga Tej Starrer Sambarala Yeti Gattu Holds Firm on Sankranti Release
news.summary: Despite potential box office clashes during the festive season, the makers of Sambarala Yeti Gattu are moving ahead with their original release schedule. Producer Chaitanya Reddy confirmed that post-production work is nearly finished and the film will not back out of the Sankranti race. Directed by Rohith KP, the action entertainer features Sai Durga Tej alongside a notable ensemble cast.

news.title: NTR Set to Restart Dragon Filming in Mumbai Next Month
news.summary: Actor NTR, who took a temporary break following a shoulder injury, will get back to work on his upcoming project Dragon starting October 10. While director Prashanth Neel utilized the downtime to film other sequences, the upcoming two-week schedule in Mumbai will feature a high-voltage action stunt. The team aims to wrap up all remaining pending portions before the year concludes.

news.title: Anil Ravipudi Nears Completion of January 12 Vidudala Shoot
news.summary: Director Anil Ravipudi is racing toward the finish line with his upcoming film January 12 Vidudala, maintaining his reputation for rapid production schedules. The upcoming Ooty schedule in early October will focus on remaining scenes and foreign song sequences, with overall filming expected to wrap by mid-November. The project stars Venkatesh, Kalyanram, Keerthy Suresh, and Krithi Shetty in lead roles.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Box Office Momentum on Day Three
news.summary: Nani's latest release, The Paradise, continues to pull strong numbers at the box office following a record-breaking opening. Family audiences and general moviegoers have crowded theaters over the weekend, resulting in robust advance bookings for Sunday. Directed by Srikanth Odela, the project has emerged as a massive commercial success for the actor.

news.title: Chakkora Trailer Sets Stage For A Unique Musical Romance With A Mystery Twist
news.summary: The theatrical preview for Chakkora – Lunar Love Bird has debuted in Hyderabad, showcasing a vibrant mix of youthful romance and family drama. The plot follows a carefree young man whose life upends when the woman he loves vanishes mysteriously. Directed by Manga Srinivas, the movie is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 9.

news.title: Breathtaking New Stills From Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana Highlight Scale And Devotion
news.summary: Fresh promotional material for the highly anticipated mythological adaptation Ramayana has given audiences a closer look at its divine aesthetics and principal cast. The newly released imagery showcases Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, and Ravi Dubey as Ram, Sita, and Lakshman alongside the first look of Yash as the formidable Ravana. Part 1 of the epic project is scheduled to hit screens during Diwali 2026.

news.title: Fresh Sneak Peek Of Chakkora Blends Youthful Energy With Gripping Suspense
news.summary: Starring Sravan and Malaika T. Vasupal, the upcoming romantic drama Chakkora has unveiled a promotional trailer highlighting its transition from lighthearted romance to a tense mystery. Helmed by debutant director Manga Srinivas, the musical project features a background score by Prince Henry. The film aims to offer Telugu filmgoers a novel storytelling experience when it arrives in cinemas globally next month.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Strong Box Office Momentum Over Opening Weekend
news.summary: Despite facing mixed critical reactions upon its early release, Nani's latest movie The Paradise has defied expectations by pulling in solid theatrical revenues. According to the production team, the film amassed a worldwide gross of 136 crore rupees across its first three days while eyeing strong overseas milestones. Director Srikanth Odela and producer Sudhakar Cherukuri's project continues to enjoy healthy numbers heading into Sunday.

news.title: NTR Set to Resume Action Sequences for Dragon in Mumbai
news.summary: Actor NTR is recovering from a shoulder injury and will restart shooting for the pan-India film Dragon on October 10. The upcoming 15-day schedule in Mumbai will feature heavy action segments with NTR and Anil Kapoor. Directed by Prashanth Neel, the Mythri Movie Makers production is currently slated for a June 2027 release.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Approaches Critical Box Office Monday
news.summary: Nani's big-budget venture The Paradise enjoyed a strong opening weekend, grossing around ₹120 crore by Saturday and heading toward ₹150 crore by Sunday night against a ₹220 crore target. Despite mixed critical feedback regarding its emotional depth and screenplay, the movie benefits from having no major theatrical competition in the coming week. Trade analysts note that Monday's ticket sales will be crucial for its long-term financial recovery.

news.title: Fresh Character Posters Released for Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana
news.summary: The makers of the two-part epic adaptation Ramayana have launched striking new character posters highlighting Yash as Ravana alongside the core trio of Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and backed by Namit Malhotra and Monster Mind Creations, the project features a score composed by AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. The ambitious cinematic venture is scheduled to arrive in theaters for Diwali 2026 and Diwali 2027.

news.title: Special Character Teaser Planned to Reveal Tabu's Role in King100
news.summary: Nagarjuna Akkineni's milestone project King100 is gearing up to unveil a dedicated teaser introducing actress Tabu's character in the film. This movie marks a major onscreen reunion for Nagarjuna and Tabu, who previously starred together in the 1990s classic Ninne Pelladutha. Directed by Ra Karthik, the film is scheduled for release on December 24, 2026.

news.title: Vijay Deverakonda's Historical Drama 'Ranabaali' Expands Promotion With 4-Part Docuseries
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan's upcoming historical project Ranabaali starring Vijay Deverakonda is launching a four-part promotional docuseries titled Ranabaali: Never Forget. The project, backed by Mythri Movie Makers and scheduled for an October 16, 2026 release, explores British-era suppression in Rayalaseema. Cast members and the director will feature in the series to discuss two years of historical research.

news.title: BRS Leader KTR Praises Nani and Srikanth Odela Following Special Screening of 'The Paradise'
news.summary: BRS Working President KTR attended a screening of Nani's latest release The Paradise at Hyderabad's Sudarshan Theatre alongside various public representatives. He commended the cast, crew, and director Srikanth Odela for delivering a powerful visual narrative depicting Telangana's cultural identity and community resistance. The leader praised how the film authentically captures the struggles of an oppressed populace.

news.title: Industry Buzz Points to Stronger Digital Valuation for Rashmika Mandanna Over Sai Pallavi
news.summary: Recent trade discussions suggest that digital streaming platforms assign a higher valuation to female-centric projects headlined by Rashmika Mandanna compared to Sai Pallavi. Industry insiders attribute this difference to Rashmika's involvement in pan-Indian blockbusters and her substantial social media presence. Meanwhile, a major digital platform has reportedly finalized an agreement for the upcoming MS Subbulakshmi biopic starring Rashmika.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Maintains Steady Ticket Sales on Day Three
news.summary: Despite receiving mixed initial reviews, the Nani-led film The Paradise continues to perform strongly at the ticket counters. On its third day, the movie recorded 252K ticket sales on BookMyShow, holding steady compared to the previous day's numbers. The cast and crew recently interacted with the press to discuss their experiences working on the Sudhakar Cherukuri-backed and Srikanth Odela-directed biggie.

news.title: Wildcard Contestant Mithilesh Exits Bigg Boss Telugu 10 With Cash Offer
news.summary: In a surprising development on Bigg Boss Telugu Season 10, wildcard entrant Mithilesh opted to accept a 15 lakh rupees temptation offer and walked out of the house. Entering the reality show just a day prior, Mithilesh defended his abrupt departure by stating that the house dynamics made it impossible for him to win. This marks an unprecedented early exit in the history of the television program.

news.title: Nani Calls The Paradise a Long-Distance Runner at Hyderabad Press Meet
news.summary: During a recent media interaction in Hyderabad, actor Nani expressed his joy over audiences eventually embracing The Paradise after an initial turnaround in public response. He praised the entire technical crew, director Srikanth Odela, and co-stars including Mohan Babu and Priyadarshi for their dedication. Nani described the project as a horse built for a long race, highlighting the immense effort put in by the entire team.

news.title: Mohan Babu Calls His Role in The Paradise the Deadliest of His Career
news.summary: Veteran actor Mohan Babu shared his experience working on The Paradise during a recent press meet in Hyderabad alongside the film's cast and crew. He praised director Srikanth Odela's clear vision and revealed that he took the most retakes of his five-decade career to nail his intense character. The veteran star also commended producer Sudhakar Cherukuri for his unwavering financial support and lauded lead actor Nani's phenomenal work ethic.

news.title: Nani Highlights Unusual Audience Trend For The Paradise
news.summary: Actor Nani shared that his latest film, The Paradise, experienced a rare box-office trend where audience reception improved from negative to positive with each passing screening. Directed by Srikanth Odela and backed by producer Sudhakar Cherukuri, the project features a stellar cast including Mohan Babu, Raghav Juyal, Sonali Kulkarni, and Kayadu Lohar.
